data.gender_notes: Ritwika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ritwika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rit' meaning knowledge and 'Wika' meaning goddess. It is believed that the goddess Ritwika imparts wisdom and knowledge to her devotees. The name Ritwika carries the meaning “Goddess of wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Ritwika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ritwika represents the divine goddess of wisdom and knowledge. It is a powerful name that is associated with enlightenment, intelligence, and knowledge.
data.etymology: Ritwika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ritwika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Ritwika was a famous Vedic poetess and is believed to have composed hymns in the Rigveda, the oldest known Hindu scripture. She is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and learning.

Ritwika is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. Here, she is portrayed as a skilled musician and dancer, and is invited to perform at the royal court of King Yudhishthira.
